description: This file defines a class 'FeaturePropertyCreatedStrategy' that handles 'FeaturePropertyCreated' events within a persistence strategy context, using Eclipse Ditto model classes to modify 'ThingBuilder' instances.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final, immutable class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to process FeaturePropertyCreated events and update ThingBuilder instances accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle FeaturePropertyCreated events, applying updates to the ThingBuilder by setting feature properties.
